--
-- An algebra isomorphic to B is a homomorphic image of B.
--
module Homomorphism-isomorph-is-image where

open import AgdaDojang.Debug

open import Level                                   using ( Level )
open import Overture                                using ( 𝓞 ; 𝓥 ; Signature )
open import Setoid.Algebras                         using ( Algebra )
open import Setoid.Homomorphisms.Isomorphisms       using ( _≅_ ; ≅-refl )

module _ {α ρᵃ : Level} {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥} {𝑨 𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ} where

  isomorph-is-image : 𝑨 ≅ 𝑩 → 𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑩
  isomorph-is-image A≅B = {!!}

8	#### Homomorphic images of setoid algebras
9	
10	This is the [Setoid.Homomorphisms.HomomorphicImages][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][].
11	
12	<!--
13	```agda

16	module Setoid.Homomorphisms.HomomorphicImages where

29	open import Overture                           using  ( proj₁ ; proj₂ ; ArityOf ; 𝑆 )
30	open import Setoid.Algebras                    using  ( Algebra ; ov ; _^_ ; 𝔻[_]
31	                                                      ; Lift-Algˡ ; Lift-Alg ; 𝕌[_] )
32	open import Setoid.Functions                   using  (IsSurjective; Image_∋_ ; Ran
33	                                                      ; range ; preimage ; image ; Inv
34	                                                      ; preimage≈image ; lift∼lower
35	                                                      ; InvIsInverseʳ ; ⊙-IsSurjective)
36	open import Setoid.Homomorphisms.Basic         using  ( hom ; IsHom ; 𝒾𝒹 )
37	open import Setoid.Homomorphisms.Isomorphisms  using  ( _≅_ ; Lift-≅ )
38	open import Setoid.Homomorphisms.Properties    using  ( Lift-homˡ ; ToLiftˡ
39	                                                      ; lift-hom-lemma ; ⊙-hom )

42	open Algebra

44	private variable α ρᵃ β ρᵇ : Level
45	```
46	-->
47	
48	We begin with what seems, for our purposes, the most useful way to represent the
49	class of *homomorphic images* of an algebra in dependent type theory.
50	
51	```agda
52	open IsHom
53	
54	_IsHomImageOf_ : (𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ)(𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ) → Type _
55	𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨 = Σ[ (φ , _ ) ∈ hom 𝑨 𝑩 ] IsSurjective φ
56	
57	HomImages : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ → Type (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov {𝑆 = 𝑆} (β ⊔ ρᵇ))
58	HomImages {β = β}{ρᵇ} 𝑨 = Σ[ 𝑩 ∈ Algebra β ρᵇ ] 𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨
59	
60	IdHomImage : {𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ} → 𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑨
61	IdHomImage {𝑨 = 𝑨} = 𝒾𝒹 , λ {y} → Image_∋_.eq y (Setoid.refl 𝔻[ 𝑨 ])
62	```
63	
64	
65	These types should be self-explanatory, but just to be sure, let's describe the
66	Sigma type appearing in the second definition. Given an `𝑆`-algebra
67	`𝑨 : Algebra α ρ`, the type `HomImages 𝑨` denotes the class `𝒦` of algebras such
68	that `𝑩 ∈ 𝒦` provided there is a surjective homomorphism from `𝑨` to `𝑩`.
69	
70	#### The image algebra of a hom
71	
72	Here we show how to construct a Algebra (called `ImageAlgebra` below) that is
73	the image of given hom.
74	
75	
76	```agda
77	module _ {𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ}{𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ} where
78	  open Algebra 𝑩  using () renaming (Domain to B ; Interp to InterpB )
79	  open Setoid B   using () renaming ( _≈_ to _≈₂_ ; trans to trans₂ )
80	  open Func       using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
81	
82	  HomImageOf[_] : hom 𝑨 𝑩 → Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} (α ⊔ β ⊔ ρᵇ) ρᵇ
83	  HomImageOf[ (h , hh) ] =
84	    record { Domain = Ran h ; Interp = record { to = f' ; cong = cong' } }
85	      where
86	      open Setoid(⟨ 𝑆 ⟩ (Ran h))
87	        using() renaming (Carrier to SRanh ; _≈_ to _≈₃_ )
88	      hhom :  ∀ {𝑓}(x : ArityOf 𝑆 𝑓 → range h)
89	        → h ⟨$⟩ (𝑓 ^ 𝑨) (preimage h ∘ x) ≈₂ (𝑓 ^ 𝑩) (image h ∘ x)
90	
91	      hhom {𝑓} x = trans₂ (hh .compatible) (cong InterpB (refl , preimage≈image h ∘ x))
92	
93	      f' : SRanh → range h
94	      f' (𝑓 , x) =  (𝑓 ^ 𝑩)(image h ∘ x)       -- b : the image in ∣B∣
95	                    , (𝑓 ^ 𝑨)(preimage h ∘ x)  -- a : the preimage in ∣A∣
96	                    , hhom x                   -- p : proof that h ⟨$⟩ a ≈₂ b
97	
98	      cong' : ∀ {x y} → x ≈₃ y → (image h) (f' x) ≈₂ (image h) (f' y)
99	      cong' {(𝑓 , u)} {(.𝑓 , v)} (refl , EqA) = Goal
100	        where
101	        -- Alternative formulation of the goal:
102	        goal : (𝑓 ^ 𝑩)(λ i → (image h)(u i)) ≈₂ (𝑓 ^ 𝑩)(λ i → (image h) (v i))
103	        goal = cong InterpB (refl , EqA )
104	
105	        Goal : (image h) (f' (𝑓 , u)) ≈₂ (image h) (f' (𝑓 , v))
106	        Goal = goal
107	        -- Note: `EqA : ∀ i → (image h) (u i) ≈₂ (image h) (v i)`
108	```
109	
110	
111	#### Homomorphic images of classes of setoid algebras
112	
113	Given a class `𝒦` of `𝑆`-algebras, we need a type that expresses the assertion that a given algebra is a homomorphic image of some algebra in the class, as well as a type that represents all such homomorphic images.
114	
115	
116	```agda
117	IsHomImageOfClass : {𝒦 : Pred (Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ)(suc α)} → Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ → Type (ov {𝑆 = 𝑆} (α ⊔ ρᵃ))
118	IsHomImageOfClass {𝒦 = 𝒦} 𝑩 = Σ[ 𝑨 ∈ Algebra _ _ ] ((𝑨 ∈ 𝒦) ∧ (𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨))
119	
120	HomImageOfClass : Pred (Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ) (suc α) → Type (ov {𝑆 = 𝑆} (α ⊔ ρᵃ))
121	HomImageOfClass 𝒦 = Σ[ 𝑩 ∈ Algebra _ _ ] IsHomImageOfClass {𝒦 = 𝒦} 𝑩
122	```
123	
124	#### Lifting tools
125	
126	Here are some tools that have been useful (e.g., in the road to the proof of
127	Birkhoff's HSP theorem). The first states and proves the simple fact that the lift of
128	an epimorphism is an epimorphism.
129	
130	```agda
131	module _ {𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ}{𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ} where
132	  open Setoid 𝔻[ 𝑩 ]   using ( sym ; trans )  renaming ( _≈_ to _≈₂_ )
133	  open Func       using ( cong )         renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
134	  open Level      using ( lift ; lower )
135	
136	  Lift-epi-is-epiˡ :  (h : hom 𝑨 𝑩)(ℓᵃ ℓᵇ : Level)
137	    → IsSurjective (proj₁ h) → IsSurjective (proj₁ (Lift-homˡ {𝑨 = 𝑨}{𝑩} h ℓᵃ ℓᵇ))
138	
139	  Lift-epi-is-epiˡ h ℓᵃ ℓᵇ hepi {b} = Goal
140	    where
141	    open Setoid 𝔻[ Lift-Algˡ 𝑩 ℓᵇ ] using ( _≈_ )
142	
143	    a : 𝕌[ 𝑨 ]
144	    a = Inv (h .proj₁) hepi
145	
146	    lem1 : b ≈ lift (lower b)
147	    lem1 = lift∼lower {𝑨 = 𝔻[ 𝑩 ]} b
148	
149	    lem2' : lower b ≈₂ h .proj₁ ⟨$⟩ a
150	    lem2' = sym  (InvIsInverseʳ hepi)
151	
152	    lem2 : lift (lower b) ≈ lift (h .proj₁ ⟨$⟩ a)
153	    lem2 = cong{From = 𝔻[ 𝑩 ]} (ToLiftˡ{𝑨 = 𝑩}{ℓᵇ} .proj₁) lem2'
154	
155	    lem3 : lift (h .proj₁ ⟨$⟩ a) ≈ (Lift-homˡ h ℓᵃ ℓᵇ) .proj₁ ⟨$⟩ lift a
156	    lem3 = lift-hom-lemma h a ℓᵃ ℓᵇ
157	
158	    η : b ≈ (Lift-homˡ h ℓᵃ ℓᵇ) .proj₁ ⟨$⟩ lift a
159	    η = trans lem1 (trans lem2 lem3)
160	
161	    Goal : Image (Lift-homˡ h ℓᵃ ℓᵇ) .proj₁ ∋ b
162	    Goal = Image_∋_.eq (lift a) η
163	
164	
165	  Lift-Alg-hom-imageˡ :  (ℓᵃ ℓᵇ : Level) → 𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨
166	    → (Lift-Algˡ 𝑩 ℓᵇ) IsHomImageOf (Lift-Algˡ 𝑨 ℓᵃ)
167	
168	  Lift-Alg-hom-imageˡ ℓᵃ ℓᵇ ((φ , φhom) , φepic) = Goal
169	    where
170	    lφ : hom (Lift-Algˡ 𝑨 ℓᵃ) (Lift-Algˡ 𝑩 ℓᵇ)
171	    lφ = Lift-homˡ {𝑨 = 𝑨}{𝑩} (φ , φhom) ℓᵃ ℓᵇ
172	
173	    lφepic : IsSurjective (lφ .proj₁)
174	    lφepic = Lift-epi-is-epiˡ (φ , φhom) ℓᵃ ℓᵇ φepic
175	    Goal : (Lift-Algˡ 𝑩 ℓᵇ) IsHomImageOf (Lift-Algˡ 𝑨 ℓᵃ)
176	    Goal = lφ , lφepic
177	
178	
179	module _ {𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ}{𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ} where
180	  open _≅_
181	  Lift-HomImage-lemma : ∀{γ} → (Lift-Alg 𝑨 γ γ) IsHomImageOf 𝑩 → 𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑩
182	  Lift-HomImage-lemma {γ} φ =  ⊙-hom (φ .proj₁) (from Lift-≅) ,
183	                               ⊙-IsSurjective (φ .proj₂) (fromIsSurjective (Lift-≅{𝑨 = 𝑨}))
184	
185	module _ {𝑨 𝑨' : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ}{𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ} where
186	  open _≅_
187	  HomImage-≅ : 𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑨' → 𝑨 ≅ 𝑩 → 𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨'
188	  HomImage-≅ φ A≅B = ⊙-hom (φ .proj₁) (to A≅B) , ⊙-IsSurjective (φ .proj₂) (toIsSurjective A≅B)
189	
190	  HomImage-≅' : 𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑨' → 𝑨' ≅ 𝑩 → 𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑩
191	  HomImage-≅' φ A'≅B = (⊙-hom (from A'≅B) (proj₁ φ)) , ⊙-IsSurjective (fromIsSurjective A'≅B) (φ .proj₂)
192	```

n---
layout: default
title : "Setoid.Homomorphisms.HomomorphicImages module (The Agda Universal Algebra Library)"
date : "2021-09-14"
author: "agda-algebras development team"
---

#### Homomorphic images of setoid algebras

This is the [Setoid.Homomorphisms.HomomorphicImages][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][].

<!--
```agda
{-# OPTIONS --cubical-compatible --exact-split --safe #-}

module Setoid.Homomorphisms.HomomorphicImages where

open import Agda.Primitive using () renaming ( Set to Type )

-- Imports from the Agda Standard Library ----------------------------------------------------
open import Data.Product  renaming ( _×_ to _∧_ )  using ( _,_ ; Σ-syntax )
open import Function                               using ( Func ; _∘_ )
open import Level                                  using ( Level ; _⊔_ ; suc )
open import Relation.Binary                        using ( Setoid )
open import Relation.Unary                         using ( Pred ; _∈_ )
open import Relation.Binary.PropositionalEquality  using (refl)

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library ---------------------------------------------
open import Overture                           using  ( proj₁ ; proj₂ ; ArityOf ; 𝑆 )
open import Setoid.Algebras                    using  ( Algebra ; ov ; _^_ ; 𝔻[_]
                                                      ; Lift-Algˡ ; Lift-Alg ; 𝕌[_] )
open import Setoid.Functions                   using  (IsSurjective; Image_∋_ ; Ran
                                                      ; range ; preimage ; image ; Inv
                                                      ; preimage≈image ; lift∼lower
                                                      ; InvIsInverseʳ ; ⊙-IsSurjective)
open import Setoid.Homomorphisms.Basic         using  ( hom ; IsHom ; 𝒾𝒹 )
open import Setoid.Homomorphisms.Isomorphisms  using  ( _≅_ ; Lift-≅ )
open import Setoid.Homomorphisms.Properties    using  ( Lift-homˡ ; ToLiftˡ
                                                      ; lift-hom-lemma ; ⊙-hom )
open import Setoid.Signatures                  using  ( ⟨_⟩ )

open Algebra

private variable α ρᵃ β ρᵇ : Level
```
-->

We begin with what seems, for our purposes, the most useful way to represent the
class of *homomorphic images* of an algebra in dependent type theory.

```agda
open IsHom

_IsHomImageOf_ : (𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ)(𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ) → Type _
𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨 = Σ[ (φ , _ ) ∈ hom 𝑨 𝑩 ] IsSurjective φ

HomImages : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ → Type (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov {𝑆 = 𝑆} (β ⊔ ρᵇ))
HomImages {β = β}{ρᵇ} 𝑨 = Σ[ 𝑩 ∈ Algebra β ρᵇ ] 𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨

IdHomImage : {𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ} → 𝑨 IsHomImageOf 𝑨
IdHomImage {𝑨 = 𝑨} = 𝒾𝒹 , λ {y} → Image_∋_.eq y (Setoid.refl 𝔻[ 𝑨 ])
```


These types should be self-explanatory, but just to be sure, let's describe the
Sigma type appearing in the second definition. Given an `𝑆`-algebra
`𝑨 : Algebra α ρ`, the type `HomImages 𝑨` denotes the class `𝒦` of algebras such
that `𝑩 ∈ 𝒦` provided there is a surjective homomorphism from `𝑨` to `𝑩`.

#### The image algebra of a hom

Here we show how to construct a Algebra (called `ImageAlgebra` below) that is
the image of given hom.


```agda
module _ {𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ}{𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ} where
  open Algebra 𝑩  using () renaming (Domain to B ; Interp to InterpB )
  open Setoid B   using () renaming ( _≈_ to _≈₂_ ; trans to trans₂ )
  open Func       using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )

  HomImageOf[_] : hom 𝑨 𝑩 → Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} (α ⊔ β ⊔ ρᵇ) ρᵇ
  HomImageOf[ (h , hh) ] =
    record { Domain = Ran h ; Interp = record { to = f' ; cong = cong' } }
      where
      open Setoid(⟨ 𝑆 ⟩ (Ran h))
        using() renaming (Carrier to SRanh ; _≈_ to _≈₃_ )
      hhom :  ∀ {𝑓}(x : ArityOf 𝑆 𝑓 → range h)
        → h ⟨$⟩ (𝑓 ^ 𝑨) (preimage h ∘ x) ≈₂ (𝑓 ^ 𝑩) (image h ∘ x)

      hhom {𝑓} x = trans₂ (hh .compatible) (cong InterpB (refl , preimage≈image h ∘ x))

      f' : SRanh → range h
      f' (𝑓 , x) =  (𝑓 ^ 𝑩)(image h ∘ x)       -- b : the image in ∣B∣
                    , (𝑓 ^ 𝑨)(preimage h ∘ x)  -- a : the preimage in ∣A∣
                    , hhom x                   -- p : proof that h ⟨$⟩ a ≈₂ b

      cong' : ∀ {x y} → x ≈₃ y → (image h) (f' x) ≈₂ (image h) (f' y)
      cong' {(𝑓 , u)} {(.𝑓 , v)} (refl , EqA) = Goal
        where
        -- Alternative formulation of the goal:
        goal : (𝑓 ^ 𝑩)(λ i → (image h)(u i)) ≈₂ (𝑓 ^ 𝑩)(λ i → (image h) (v i))
        goal = cong InterpB (refl , EqA )

        Goal : (image h) (f' (𝑓 , u)) ≈₂ (image h) (f' (𝑓 , v))
        Goal = goal
        -- Note: `EqA : ∀ i → (image h) (u i) ≈₂ (image h) (v i)`
```


#### Homomorphic images of classes of setoid algebras

Given a class `𝒦` of `𝑆`-algebras, we need a type that expresses the assertion that a given algebra is a homomorphic image of some algebra in the class, as well as a type that represents all such homomorphic images.


```agda
IsHomImageOfClass : {𝒦 : Pred (Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ)(suc α)} → Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ → Type (ov {𝑆 = 𝑆} (α ⊔ ρᵃ))
IsHomImageOfClass {𝒦 = 𝒦} 𝑩 = Σ[ 𝑨 ∈ Algebra _ _ ] ((𝑨 ∈ 𝒦) ∧ (𝑩 IsHomImageOf 𝑨))

HomImageOfClass : Pred (Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ) (suc α) → Type (ov {𝑆 = 𝑆} (α ⊔ ρᵃ))
HomImageOfClass 𝒦 = Σ[ 𝑩 ∈ Algebra _ _ ] IsHomImageOfClass {𝒦 = 𝒦} 𝑩
```

#### Lifting tools

Here are some tools that have been useful (e.g., in the road to the proof of
Birkhoff's HSP theorem). The first states and proves the simple fact that the lift of
an epimorphism is an epimorphism.

```agda
module _ {𝑨 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} α ρᵃ}{𝑩 : Algebra {𝑆 = 𝑆} β ρᵇ} where
  open Setoid 𝔻[ 𝑩 ]   using ( sym ; trans )  renaming ( _≈_ to _≈₂_ )
  open Func       using ( cong )         renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
  open Level      using ( lift ; lower )

  Lift-epi-is-epiˡ :  (h : hom 𝑨 𝑩)(ℓᵃ ℓᵇ : Level)
    → IsSurjective (proj₁ h) → IsSurjective (proj₁ (Lift-homˡ {𝑨 = 𝑨}{𝑩} h ℓᵃ ℓᵇ))

  Lift-epi-is-epiˡ h ℓᵃ ℓᵇ hepi {b} = Goal
    where
    open Setoid 𝔻[ Lift-Algˡ 𝑩 ℓᵇ ] using ( _≈_ )

    a : 𝕌[ 𝑨 ]
    a = Inv (h .proj₁) hepi

    lem1 : b ≈ lift (lower b)
    lem1 = lift∼lower {𝑨 = 𝔻[ 𝑩 ]} b

    lem2' : lower b ≈₂ h .proj₁ ⟨$⟩ a
    lem2' = sym  (InvIsInverseʳ hepi)

    lem2 : lift (lower b) ≈ lift (h .proj₁ ⟨$⟩ a)
```
